title: Removal of luck
note: Every figure below is computed by scripts/build_luck_g.py from data/results.tsv (137 official 2026 results) using engine/luck.py. No market price is used anywhere in this panel: a luck band needs a base rate and a sample size, not a price. Where a base rate cannot be measured from an official source the row is blank and says why.

headline.verdict: The home-team hit rate over 137 official games is 48.9%. Its 95% interval is 40.7% to 57.2%, which contains 50%. On this sample, backing the home team every time is indistinguishable from a coin flip — which is exactly the point: a season is not long enough for a small edge to become visible.

brier.note: Both forecasts are constants: they say the same number for every game. The skill score of 0.0005 is what 'no skill' looks like on a proper score. Any strategy must beat this, not beat zero.

multiplicity.note: Ranking the best of 6 strategies without adjusting the threshold is how a lucky run gets mistaken for a method. With the Bonferroni-adjusted threshold the 5pp-edge sample rises from 785 to 1211 decisions.

clustering.icc_note: The intra-cluster correlation between legs of the same game is NOT measured in this repository — no joint-outcome source has been captured. The grid below is therefore a sensitivity, not an estimate: it shows how fast the required sample grows if legs inside one game are correlated at all.
